issues.detail: The Greek 'εγενετο η βασιλεια αυτου εσκοτωμενη' refers to the 'kingdom of it' (the beast) becoming 'desolated' or 'devastated'. The Vietnamese translation 'nước của nó trở nên tối tăm' (its water became dark) is a complete mistranslation of the subject and the state described.
The Greek 'εμασσωντο τας γλωσσας αυτων' refers to 'their tongues' (plural), whereas the Vietnamese 'người ta cắn lưỡi mình' translates it as 'people biting their own tongues'.
